$comment: Copy to <repo>/.claude/dispatch.json (or ~/.dispatch/config.json). Every model id below is an example read from `opencode models` / `agy models` on 2026-10-12; re-read yours.

ladder.note: Free Zen models, 'limited time'. run.sh keeps only the ones `opencode models` still lists, in this order.
Antigravity on the Google plan. Settles its own questions in print mode; refused actions arrive in denied_actions.
claude -p on the Claude plan. Shares the usage window with the coordinator session, hence last.

checklist: Every item of the prompt: done / partly / not done / done wrong, with file:line and a quote.
For every new or changed test: if the feature were broken, would it still pass? A test that mocks the subject, or asserts only constants or ok, is hollow.
No invented constants: every model id, price, flag, endpoint, slug in the diff names its source (vendor page, models endpoint, --help, docs).
Credentials never in config, env, logs, API responses or a command line.
No test reaches a real host; no live CLI run; nothing started.
Files touched outside the prompt's scope: list each with a judgement.
Claims in the commit body that the diff does not support (quoted --help lines, gate results).
